in_sanskrit.name: Anma
in_sanskrit.meaning: हिन्दू नाम जिसका अर्थ है Nourishment, Grace
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: Anma एक संस्कृत नाम है जो हिंदू संस्कृति में गहरा आध्यात्मिक महत्व रखता है। Anma is a Sanskrit name derived from the word ‘an’ meaning grace or nourishment and ‘ma’ meaning mother. It is a beautiful and meaningful name for a baby girl in Hindu tradition. In Hindu mythology, Anma is also associated with the goddess Annapurna, who is the goddess of food and nourishment.
